description:
Thank you to all the guests for their wonderful speeches and valuable insights at the Marvelous Designer 2025 Shanghai User Conference!

In this conference, we delved into the powerful appeal of Marvelous Designer in game development and virtual creation. The presentations covered practical tips for designing game character clothing, as well as a special explanation of how Marvelous Designer integrates with Unreal Engine to enhance the realism of virtual garments, from the collaborative growth with users to the exciting release of new features in 2025.

Don't miss out on this fantastic content!

Now, I will briefly share the purpose of my role in our project. In the previous video, I shared the purpose of my role. My project is relatively simple. In the current project, the quality is not as good as the 3D one, but we want to improve the quality in this direction. ## Project Overview Our current project is more like a traditional martial arts project. It uses Level of Detail (LOD). The challenge we face is that many materials are counter-gravity. In order to make it look good, it is not calculated by the weight. To achieve this effect, I used many techniques. ### Material Analysis First, we look at the original painting and analyze it to determine which materials are used. We utilize Marvelous Designer (M.D.) to find the materials and on the paint. Then I use a brush to draw the details. On the right is the final M.D. effect. ## Common Problems Encountered I know that some of you may have encountered many problems: ### Issue 1: Anti-Chinese Style Clothing The first issue is that in the clothing department, the most common is this kind of anti-Chinese style. The upper half of the clothes has more layers, at least three layers, and the lower half also has more layers, at least three layers. If you write it in a natural way, you won't be able to achieve the effect of this kind of anti-Chinese style. #### Collar Design The collar of the anti-Chinese style needs special attention. To make it a little more formal, I will draw a shadow to give it more three-dimensionality. If we untie it, it will be affected by gravity, causing this part to fall to the top of the clothes. Therefore, I will draw this effect. ### Fixing the Collar First, fix the nail to the foot of the collar where you want it to be stiff. Then adjust your plate. After adjusting it, you can use this technique to add a little bit of shape and fix it. If it’s not done correctly, it will be loose and not look natural. ### Issue 2: Wear and Tear of Clothing The second problem is the wear and tear of the clothes. When we make clothes, there is a lot of wear and tear. If you sew it too tightly, there will be a conflict in the layers. Therefore, when we make the film, there must be a certain distance between the layers; we can't pull them too close like we do in manual work. ### Issue 3: Layer Settings The third problem is related to setting the number of layers. You can set the outer layer to 1 and the inner layer to 2. If you set the number of layers and then cut them, there will be no conflict. After cutting all three layers, you can reset the number of layers for normal functionality. ## Inner Layer Considerations When we make clothes, we must add the inner layer. We use the seam allowance to create the layers. The upper layer is the main layer, and the bottom layer is the lining, which should have a wave effect. ### Sewing Techniques We don’t connect the seam allowance to the outer layer directly; instead, we use a needle to poke the outer layer and perform some open operations before sewing it up. Ensure that the inner line aligns with the center line and add it where you need to create the shape. ## Finalizing Fabric Patterns Now, we are working on the basic pattern. We need to make it look like this while adding the necessary inner lines. After that, we can put it in the belt to achieve a special effect. ### Achieving Desired Effects After completing the effect, we need to put it in the belt naturally. We may need to adjust the inner line after a short period to achieve the desired shape. Gradually, it will form the effect we want. ## Utilizing Blower Tools To achieve this effect, we will use M.D.’s blower. This blower allows us to blow air to the desired position, adjusting the particle diameter to prevent overflow. After blowing it to the longest position, we will let it fall freely until it returns to its natural state. ## Material Import and Configuration After introducing the materials, we need to import them into our layout and configuration. Once we import the materials, we must adjust their intensity to achieve the desired effects. ### Waste Material Management When dealing with waste materials, we need to gather everything together. After importing the materials, we can separate them for adjustments. ## Final Steps in Material Creation Once the materials are removed from the surface, we will distribute them according to the board size and increase their thickness. It is easier to control thickness in 3D modeling software than in M.D. ### Achieving High-Quality Molds After adding the texture details in M.D., we will print them to achieve a high-quality mold. ## Reflections on Using Marvelous Designer There are two main points I would like to highlight regarding our use of M.D. 1. **Natural Material Creation**: M.D. allows for very natural material creation and greatly reduces the time spent on hand carving, which requires high precision. 2. **Fire Usage for Effects**: When we use M.D., we sometimes need to apply fire to achieve the desired effects. We must be careful with the board and adjust it according to our actual situation to ensure it does not negatively impact the game performance. ## Conclusion We have been using M.D. for quite some time, especially in combat painting. While it may not be suitable for every aspect of game development, it has proven beneficial in many areas. Thank you for your attention today. ```
